title: Harrowing — Modernised Techniques, Enduring Memory
description: Modernised techniques and tractors with harrows made the farm more efficient, increasing production. As a result, the early cottage farms grew larger and were eventually swallowed by large corporate farms. Even though the old way has faded, the memory remains: weathered, worn barns and stone piles in old fields, along with stories still passed from one generation to the next.
